verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents an API endpoint to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer, a permission to "Monitor and unmonitor customers", and an endpoint to read a customer's monitor status. Together these give per-customer enable/disable of ongoing screening, but only through single-customer API calls. missing for 10: a documented web-app control for compliance officers to toggle monitoring, bulk enable/disable for a selected set of customers, detailed docs on the on/off behaviour, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers

citations.quote: This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.
This endpoint returns the monitor status for a single customer.
